question: How much of this class or trigger do tests cover?

steps.name: coverage
steps.soql: SELECT ApexClassOrTrigger.Name, NumLinesCovered, NumLinesUncovered FROM ApexCodeCoverageAggregate WHERE ApexClassOrTrigger.Name = '{name}'

verdicts.say: No coverage recorded for {name}. Run its tests first.

traps: Coverage reflects the last test run on this org, not the current code if it changed since.
